experiment: E5 pause/resume/steer/cancel semantics, ported as Go regression tests
checks: C1 PauseOnStart blocks before the first model request
C2 mid-run user message via second RunAgent is refused
C3 steer (EditTaskState brief) queued while paused is visible in the next model request
C3b injected text through RunAgent never reached the model
C3c the steer is not one model turn late: it reaches request 1 and is applied once
C5 pause during a running tool settles at the next safe boundary after the tool finishes
C6 cancel while paused stops the run without a further model request
C7 resume = new Start; the completed bash call is not replayed
C8 Hub view is available for a plain session
note: E5 C5's original file-existence observation was ambiguous (the raw run reported tool_output_exists=true for a completed tool); this port asserts the tool's own result row is present instead, which is the property C5 is about.
